title: GUI-CC：GUI世界模型作为智能体环境的上下文一致性基准
summary: GUI-CC基准测试评估GUI世界模型作为智能体环境时的上下文一致性，而非仅作为单步屏幕预测器。包含离线参考动作和在线智能体循环两个轨道，基于GUIOdyssey构建500个离线任务和200个在线任务，评估转换保真度、合理性、上下文一致性和任务进展。实验表明，合理的单步生成不保证可靠的环境模拟。
summary_en: GUI-CC benchmark evaluates contextual consistency of GUI world models as agent environments, not just next-screen predictors. It includes offline and online tracks with 500+200 tasks, assessing transition fidelity, plausibility, consistency, and task progress. Findings show plausible single-step generation doesn't guarantee reliable multi-step environment simulation.
